findings.name: 农安佳加乐超市动漫城
findings.evidence_quote: BEMANICN lists 1x 鼓王 (title_id 22, ver 3). No maimai/CHUNITHM/WACCA/舞立方 or other international rhythm titles.
findings.note: 鼓王 is a Chinese drum music game mapped to slug other. No standard SEGA/Konami rhythm cabinets listed.

findings.name: 博禹动漫世界
findings.evidence_quote: Comment: 无音游区 / 2025.2.1 多了两台e舞，没有吴丽芳. Arcades: 1x 鼓王, 2x 头文字D.
findings.note: Editor says no music-game area; only 鼓王 + racing + later e舞 clones. 鼓王 -> other. Not confirmed_none because Chinese rhythm/drum cabs present.

findings.name: 博禹嘉年华（桦甸店）＆萌娃抓抓
findings.evidence_quote: Arcades: 5x 头文字D ARCADE STAGE 8 only. Shop comment covers hours and coins only; no positive statement that rhythm games are absent.
findings.note: BEMANICN tracks only Initial D racing here. Silence on rhythm titles is not confirmed_none.

findings.name: 欢乐谷
findings.evidence_quote: 1x maimai (old frame, title_id 2, ver.3.99). Cab comment: 机器还在...右半边屏幕黑屏...无网络，已进离线模式. Shop: 无法登陆,4币1pc. Updated 2026-07-31.
findings.note: Old CN maimai (not DX). Very poor condition, offline, 2P dead. Nearby 鑫乐迪 at same 维港城 has official 舞萌DX per WAHLAP (different venue). Do not merge.
